from paperleet.common.asserts import assert_close_diagnostic as close
import math
import pytest
import torch


def oracle(x, threshold, temperature):
    result=[]; v=x.shape[-1]
    for row in x.reshape(-1,v).tolist():
        # Scalar double arithmetic is independent of the tensor implementation.
        scaled=[value/temperature for value in row] if temperature>=1. else row
        m=max(scaled)
        weights=[math.exp(value-m if temperature>=1. else (value-m)/temperature) for value in scaled]
        total=sum(weights)
        order=sorted(range(v),key=lambda i:(-weights[i]/total,i))
        keep=[];mass=0.
        for i in order:
            keep.append(i);mass+=weights[i]/total
            if mass>=threshold and threshold!=1.:break
        retained=sum(weights[i] for i in keep)
        result.append([weights[i]/retained if i in keep else 0. for i in range(v)])
    return torch.tensor(result,dtype=x.dtype).reshape(x.shape)


@pytest.mark.t0
def test_contract(impl):
    """Candidate probabilities keep shape, dtype, device and normalized rows."""
    for dtype in (torch.float32,torch.float64):
        x=torch.zeros(2,3,4,dtype=dtype)
        out=impl.top_p_probs(x,.5)
        assert out.shape==x.shape and out.dtype==dtype and out.device==x.device
        close(out,torch.tensor([.5,.5,0.,0.],dtype=dtype).expand_as(x))


@pytest.mark.t1
def test_independent_scalar_oracle(impl):
    """Compare each row to scalar stable sorting and normalized exponential weights."""
    for dtype in (torch.float32,torch.float64):
        x=torch.tensor([[[1.,-2.,4.,.5],[0.,3.,-1.,2.]],[[4.,1.,0.,2.],[-3.,-.5,2.,1.]]],dtype=dtype)
        for threshold in (.17,.61,.93,1.):
            for temperature in (.4,1.,2.5):
                close(impl.top_p_probs(x,threshold,temperature),oracle(x,threshold,temperature))


@pytest.mark.t2
def test_extreme_and_empty_boundaries(impl):
    """Handle large finite logits, tiny temperature, one token and empty leading axes."""

    for dtype in (torch.float32,torch.float64):
        x=torch.tensor([10000.,-10000.,0.],dtype=dtype)
        out=impl.top_p_probs(x,.1,.01)
        assert torch.isfinite(out).all()
        close(out,torch.tensor([1.,0.,0.],dtype=dtype))
        one=impl.top_p_probs(torch.tensor([7.],dtype=dtype),1.)
        close(one,torch.ones(1,dtype=dtype))
        empty=impl.top_p_probs(torch.empty(0,3,dtype=dtype),.1)
        assert empty.shape==(0,3) and empty.dtype==dtype


@pytest.mark.t2
def test_full_finite_scalar_range(impl):
    """Python scalar parameters must not underflow when logits are float32."""
    cases = [
        (torch.zeros(4), 1e-60, 1., [1., 0., 0., 0.]),
        (torch.zeros(4, dtype=torch.float64), 5e-324, 1., [1., 0., 0., 0.]),
        (torch.tensor([1., 0., -1.]), .9, 1e-50, [1., 0., 0.]),
        (torch.tensor([1., 0., -1.], dtype=torch.float64), .9, 5e-324, [1., 0., 0.]),
        (torch.tensor([-2e38, 2e38]), 1., 2e38, [.119202922, .880797078]),
        (torch.tensor([-1e308, 1e308], dtype=torch.float64), 1., 1e308, [.119202922, .880797078]),
    ]
    for x, p, temperature, expected in cases:
        out = impl.top_p_probs(x, p, temperature)
        assert torch.isfinite(out).all(), (x, p, temperature)
        close(out, torch.tensor(expected, dtype=x.dtype))


@pytest.mark.t2
def test_ties_threshold_and_full_distribution(impl):
    """Honor exact tie order, boundary equality and the unfiltered limiting case."""

    x=torch.zeros(4,dtype=torch.float64)
    expected=torch.tensor([.5,.5,0.,0.],dtype=x.dtype)
    close(impl.top_p_probs(x,.5),expected)
    # Float32 input still uses double precision for the scalar threshold.
    close(impl.top_p_probs(torch.zeros(4), .5000000001),
                               torch.tensor([1/3, 1/3, 1/3, 0.]))
    # Temperature can round unequal scores to equal working probabilities.
    close(impl.top_p_probs(torch.tensor([0., 1.]), .5, 1e308),
                               torch.tensor([1., 0.]))
    x=torch.tensor([[2.,1.,2.,2.]],dtype=torch.float64)
    close(impl.top_p_probs(x,.6),oracle(x,.6,1.))
    x=torch.tensor([0.,1.,-1.,3.],dtype=torch.float64)
    for temperature in (.25,2.,5.):
        close(impl.top_p_probs(x,1.,temperature),torch.softmax(x/temperature,-1))
    x=torch.tensor([.1,.5,.15,.25],dtype=torch.float64).log()
    close(impl.top_p_probs(x,.6),torch.tensor([0.,2/3,0.,1/3],dtype=x.dtype))


@pytest.mark.t2
def test_preservation_offsets_and_strides(impl):
    """Rows are independent, inputs unchanged, and logit offsets do not affect output."""
    x=torch.tensor([[2.,9.,-1.,8.,3.,7.,0.,6.],[1.,0.,4.,0.,-2.,0.,3.,0.]],dtype=torch.float64)[:,::2]
    before=x.clone(); out=impl.top_p_probs(x,.7,.8)
    close(out,oracle(x,.7,.8))
    close(impl.top_p_probs(x+torch.tensor([[100.],[-30.]],dtype=x.dtype),.7,.8),out)
    close(x,before)
    assert (out>=0).all();close(out.sum(-1),torch.ones(2,dtype=x.dtype))

def test_candidate_distribution_experiment(impl,artifact):

from paperleet.common.asserts import assert_close_diagnostic as close
import torch


def run(solve):
    thresholds=[.1,.4,.6,.85,1.];counts=[];maxima=[]
    logits=torch.tensor([.1,.5,.15,.25],dtype=torch.float64).log()
    for p in thresholds:
        probs=solve(logits,p)
        close(probs.sum(),torch.tensor(1.,dtype=logits.dtype))
        counts.append(int((probs>0).sum()));maxima.append(probs.max().item())
    assert counts==[1,1,2,3,4]
    close(solve(logits,.6),torch.tensor([0.,2/3,0.,1/3],dtype=logits.dtype))
    observed, error = sampled_frequencies(solve(logits, .6), [0., 2/3, 0., 1/3], 42)
    sample_chart = {'kind':'line', 'title':'Actual nucleus sampling (8192 draws)',
                    'x':list(range(4)), 'x_label':'vocabulary index', 'y_label':'frequency',
                    'series':[{'name':'Independent target', 'values':[0., 2/3, 0., 1/3]},
                              {'name':'Sampled learner distribution', 'values':observed}]}
    return {'provenance':'Synthetic nucleus selection and seeded sampling from learner probabilities; no language-model quality benchmark.',
            'charts':[sample_chart,{'kind':'line','title':'Nucleus size','x':thresholds,'x_label':'p threshold','y_label':'retained candidates','series':[{'name':'Learner candidate count','values':counts}]},
                      {'kind':'line','title':'Renormalized candidate confidence','x':thresholds,'x_label':'p threshold','y_label':'largest probability','series':[{'name':'Learner maximum probability','values':maxima}]}],
            'metrics':{'sample_count':8192,'maximum_sampling_error':error,'small_nucleus':counts[0],'full_nucleus':counts[-1]}}


def sampled_frequencies(probs, expected, seed):
    # Per-backend reproducibility; NumPy and native Torch have different RNG streams.
    sample_count = 8192
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    draws = torch.multinomial(probs, sample_count, replacement=True)
    counts = torch.bincount(draws, minlength=probs.shape[-1])
    observed = counts.to(torch.float64) / sample_count
    target = torch.tensor(expected, dtype=torch.float64)
    close(probs, target)
    assert (counts[target == 0] == 0).all()
    error = float((observed - target).abs().max())
    assert error < .04  # >7 standard errors for these small categorical distributions.
    return observed.tolist(), error

import torch
from torch import Tensor

def top_p_probs(logits: Tensor, p: float, temperature: float = 1.) -> Tensor:
    # Python floats must not be narrowed to float32 (tiny p/T would become 0).
    work = logits.to(torch.float64)
    if temperature >= 1.:
        scaled = work / temperature
        scaled = scaled - scaled.amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    else:
        scaled = (work - work.amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)) / temperature
    probs = torch.softmax(scaled, dim=-1)
    order = torch.argsort(probs, dim=-1, descending=True, stable=True)
    sorted_probs = probs.gather(-1, order)
    previous = torch.cat((torch.zeros_like(sorted_probs[..., :1]), sorted_probs.cumsum(-1)[..., :-1]), dim=-1)
    keep_sorted = torch.ones_like(previous, dtype=torch.bool) if p == 1. else previous < p
    keep = keep_sorted.gather(-1, torch.argsort(order, dim=-1))
    return torch.softmax(scaled.masked_fill(~keep, float('-inf')), dim=-1).to(logits.dtype)
